definitions.explanation: A set of seven marvels or unexplained things associated with a place, such as the Seven Wonders of the World, or the seven ghost stories said to haunt a school. Also used loosely of anything puzzling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七不思議|ななふしぎ}。
examples.english: The Seven Wonders of the World.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{七不思議|ななふしぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Our school has its seven mysteries too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{音楽室|おんがくしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}る→鳴る：01143_naru⟧というのは、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七不思議|ななふしぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The piano in the music room that plays by itself at midnight is one of the school's seven mysteries.

notes:
Every Japanese child knows the ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七不思議|ななふしぎ}: ghost stories about the school at night (a moving anatomy model, a portrait whose eyes follow you, a toilet ghost). Places from the old Edo neighborhood of {本所|ほんじょ} to temples and lakes have their own lists. Jokingly, anything inexplicable is one of the seven wonders: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{七不思議|ななふしぎ}.
